messages:
maya (product): quick sync — we need a compact plan for the pilot greenlist + dropout mitigation before next Thurs. thoughts?
liam (eng): agree. we should cap active pilots to 12 per region to keep infra predictable.
ana (solutions): +1. also want clarity on required integration depth. some partners will just hit the hosted API vs private deploys.
jo n (research): suggestion: two buckets — lightweight (API-only, 1 hr setup) and deep (onboarding, 2+ dev weeks). different incentives.
tina (growth): incentives idea: early-credits + prioritized roadmap input for deep partners. for lightweight, smaller credit + feature highlight in launch.
sam (pm): ok — commitment criteria proposal: lightweight = 4 weeks participation, 1 feedback session, 3 completed eval prompts; deep = 8 weeks, weekly checkpoints, share logs/evals.
maya (product): that sounds reasonable. what about dropout mitigation? we had 30% no-shows last pilot. need firm cancellation policy.
recruitbot (bot): candidate pool report: 42 interested, region split: NA 20, EU 15, APAC 7. average company size = 150-800 FTE.
liam (eng): mitigation tactics: 1) overbook by 25% 2) require a lightweight MOU with a single-sentence commitment 3) schedule kickoff calls in cohort slots (fixed times).
nana (solutions): add: automated setup checklist + sandbox keys 48hrs before kickoff — no checklist, no slot. reduces admin overhead.
jon (research): measurement plan: primary metrics = integration time, # of regressions caught, qualitative NPS. secondary = tokens consumed, latency delta.
sam (pm): can we make a simple tracking sheet? I'll draft columns: company, contact, bucket, onboarding status, kickoff date, feedback sessions done, churn reason.
tina (growth): I'll run the outreach copy — test A/B: credit-first vs roadmap-access-first messaging. we'll measure reply rate + commitment rate.
maya (product): legal question: data sharing & retention for deep partners. need opt-in template and minimal POI. tagging @legal-bot for the MOU text.
legal-bot: recommended clause: "Partner agrees to provide anonymized logs and evaluation prompts for quality improvement; Redwood will not retain PII beyond 90 days unless explicit consent is provided." Happy to draft full MOU.
liam (eng): rollback plan: if partner reveals production data accidentally, we should auto-revoke keys + preserve snapshot for analysis only. add to runbook.
nana (solutions): timeline check: recruiting outreach this week, interviews next 2 weeks, cohorts start in 3 weeks. does that fit?
maya (product): yes. deliverables before kickoff: 1) MOU draft (legal), 2) onboarding checklist + sandbox (eng/sol), 3) tracking sheet (pm), 4) outreach copy (growth).
sam (pm): I'll spin up the sheet and add initial 42 candidates. tagging people on rows.
tina (growth): will share outreach variants by EOD.
liam (eng): I'll prioritize a lightweight auto-provision path — ETA 10 business days.
jon (research): final ask: reserve a $5000 evaluation incentive pool for usability tests with 6 partners. helps keep deep partners engaged.
maya (product): agree to the pool. anyone object?
(no replies)
maya (product): ok locking this plan. will post a concise playbook in #product and move to a shared doc. thanks all :tada:
